task.question: Where will the 2026 African Badminton Championships take place in February 2026?
task.evidence: February 13 – 15 : 2026 African Badminton Championships in Gaborone, Botswana

answer:
The 2026 African Badminton Championships will take place at the Royal Aria in Gaborone, Botswana, from February 13 to 15, 2026. 

FINAL: Gaborone, Botswana
